signals.name: Literal corner radii
signals.note: The source uses several literal corner radii. Review them by surface and promote repeated semantic roles to shared metrics.

signals.name: Literal type sizes
signals.note: Literal text sizes coexist with the typography scale. Check whether each is an intentional optical adjustment or a missing type role.

signals.name: Pointer affordances
signals.note: These elements advertise interaction. Review keyboard, role and focus behavior; the count alone does not imply a defect.

signals.name: Explicit button roles
signals.note: Compare with pointer affordances while auditing accessible interaction paths; GPUI controls can also supply roles themselves.
